title: Graves's space situational awareness camera company

tellings.quote: started a small company that is building uh what we believe to be the next generation of space situational awareness cameras

plain: Ryan Graves, a former Navy fighter pilot who says he has seen unidentified objects in the sky, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that he has started a small company. He says it builds what his team believes will be the next generation of space situational awareness cameras, meaning cameras that watch and track things moving in orbit around Earth.
